# d2afbb1 literal defaults and viewer rows; do not regenerate from the shared table.
[actions]
NextTab	Ctrl+Tab
PreviousTab	Ctrl+Shift+Tab
Focus(Left)	Alt+H
Focus(Right)	Alt+L
Focus(Up)	Alt+K
Focus(Down)	Alt+J
FocusTabPosition	Alt+1…9 / Alt+0
ShowWorkspacePosition	Alt+Shift+1…9 / Alt+Shift+0
NextAttention	Alt+G
PreviousAttention	Alt+Shift+G
ToggleInbox	Alt+Q
CycleFocus	F6
ReturnToTerminal	Escape
TraverseChrome(Left)	Left
TraverseChrome(Right)	Right
TraverseChrome(Up)	Up
TraverseChrome(Down)	Down
CreatePane	Alt+M
CreateColumn	Ctrl+Alt+M
CreateTab	Alt+Shift+T
CloseTab	Alt+Shift+W
ClosePane	Alt+W
ToggleZoom	Alt+Shift+Z
Move(Left)	Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H
Move(Right)	Ctrl+Alt+Shift+L
MovePaneSideways(Left)	Ctrl+Alt+H
MovePaneSideways(Right)	Ctrl+Alt+L
Move(Up)	Ctrl+Alt+K
Move(Down)	Ctrl+Alt+J
NewWindow	Alt+Shift+N
Detach	Alt+Shift+D
Quit	Alt+Shift+Q
ToggleViewer	Alt+/
ToggleHints	Alt+Shift+B
ToggleSidebar	Alt+Shift+H
Copy	Ctrl+Shift+C
Paste	Ctrl+Shift+V or Paste
OpenLink	Ctrl+click
[viewer]
[Navigate]
Ctrl+Tab	Focus next tab
Ctrl+Shift+Tab	Focus previous tab
Alt+H	Focus left column or previous tab
Alt+L	Focus right column or next tab
Alt+K	Focus pane above
Alt+J	Focus pane below
Alt+1…9 / Alt+0	Focus tab by position
Alt+Shift+1…9 / Alt+Shift+0	Show session by position
Alt+G	Jump to the next agent needing attention
Alt+Shift+G	Jump to the previous agent needing attention
Alt+Q	Show the attention inbox
F6	Cycle terminal, agent sidebar, tabs, and panes
Escape	Return focus to the terminal
Left / Right	Previous or next column or tab while tabs are focused
Up / Down	Previous or next pane or agent row while one is focused
[Tabs and panes]
Alt+M	Create pane
Ctrl+Alt+M	Create column
Alt+Shift+T	Create tab
Alt+Shift+W	Close active tab
Alt+W	Close selected pane
Alt+Shift+Z	Zoom selected pane or restore columns
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H	Move tab left
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+L	Move tab right
Ctrl+Alt+H	Move pane to left column
Ctrl+Alt+L	Move pane to right column
Ctrl+Alt+K	Move pane up
Ctrl+Alt+J	Move pane down
[Host]
Alt+Shift+N	Open new Eon window
Alt+Shift+D	Detach: hide the window, keep terminals running
Alt+Shift+Q	Quit: close the window, stop its terminals
Alt+/	Show or close shortcuts
Alt+Shift+B	Show or hide shortcut hints
Alt+Shift+H	Show or hide the agent sidebar
Ctrl+Shift+C	Copy selected text or focused link
Ctrl+Shift+V or Paste	Paste
Ctrl+click	Open link
